name: Verify assistant resolves issue with knowledge article
objective: Validate that the AI Assistant retrieves and displays a relevant knowledge article when the user asks a question that matches existing knowledge.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. Knowledge articles exist in the system.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Ask a question that matches an existing knowledge article
steps.expectedResult: Message is submitted to the assistant

steps.description: Verify the assistant retrieves a relevant knowledge article
steps.expectedResult: The assistant provides an answer sourced from a knowledge article

steps.description: Verify the source knowledge article is displayed with the response
steps.expectedResult: The knowledge article title/link is shown as the source reference
